slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
disgustingly magnetic

full attention

when someone talks to you this week, put everything down and turn your whole body toward them. full attention is so rare now that people remember it as charisma.

remembering details

after every conversation, note one detail the person shared, then ask about it next time. people feel magnetic pull toward whoever remembers what mattered to them.

slower movements

move a little slower than usual for a week: walking, turning, picking things up. calm, unhurried movement reads as confidence long before you've said a word.

story collecting

spend 5 minutes a day learning one good story from history, art or science. magnetic people always have something fascinating to share, and stories travel further than facts.

story collecting

spend 5 minutes a day learning one good story from history, art or science. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and magnetic people always have something to share.

slides.texte_overlay:
the warm exit

end every conversation with something kind and specific, like "i loved hearing about your trip". people remember the last thing you made them feel, so make it good.
